**Finding: deviation (§ 12.4)** — redline validated and submitted.

Section 12.4 is a one-way restriction on us that fails the fallback on every material term: it is not mutual, runs eighteen months from termination rather than twelve months from the end of a person's involvement, sweeps in anyone employed by Vendor at any time during the term rather than only personnel directly involved in the Services, bars "engage" (a de facto no-hire), and has no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. Section 12.3's general-recruitment freedom language conflicts with it but does not cure it.

The redline narrows 12.4 to the playbook fallback — mutual, solicitation-only, involved personnel, twelve months from end of involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs — consistent with the rule's instruction to narrow rather than delete.
